referenceUse: Visually inspected for current teal and cream palette; not an edit target.

concepts.title: 01 — Dialogue
concepts.description: A bold cream speech balloon and a smaller mint reply balloon interlock through a single shared negative-space notch. Warm conversational silhouette, not two generic overlapping outlines.
concepts.palette: deep teal #126C64, warm cream #F7F3E8, small mint #A8D9C5
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Super Chat Android launcher icon concept presentation, exploratory mockup only.
Create ONE polished square comparison card for the named concept. Off-white neutral presentation background. At top left set the exact concept title in tasteful clear sans-serif type. Centre upper portion: one very large flat vector-style rounded-square launcher icon, no gradients, no shadows, no fine detail. Icon background fills the tile; the main mark fits inside the central 60 percent so circular adaptive-icon cropping preserves it. Beneath this, show three smaller faithfully identical versions at successively smaller launcher sizes, the final one genuinely tiny, plus a circular crop preview. Bottom small caption exactly "SUPER CHAT · ICON EXPLORATION". Each mark must remain bold and recognizable at 24px. Crisp professional identity exploration; no device photograph, no full phone screen, no UI, no mock 3D, no decorative symbols around the icon. Labels stay outside the icon. Never put app name inside icon. No sparkles, robot heads or circuit traces.
Title (verbatim): "01 — Dialogue".
Main concept: A bold cream speech balloon and a smaller mint reply balloon interlock through a single shared negative-space notch. Warm conversational silhouette, not two generic overlapping outlines.
Palette: deep teal #126C64, warm cream #F7F3E8, small mint #A8D9C5.
